name: green-zone-straddle-top-cross
note: TRUTH TABLE ROW — a genuine crossing of the TOP edge (high=111 > 110, low=100 < 110). Both predicates terminate at bar 2 and both mark the zone mitigated, so `mitigated_color` applies identically. A CONTROL row for the mutation proof: relaxing straddle's `>` to `>=` must leave this row untouched, which is what makes 'fails exactly the equality rows' a real claim rather than 'fails something'.
source:
indicator("SB", shorttitle="SB", overlay=true)
spawn = bar_index == 0
plotzone(spawn, high, low, "T", extend=extend.until, terminate=terminate.touch, mitigated_color=color.gray)
plotzone(spawn, high, low, "S", extend=extend.until, terminate=terminate.straddle, mitigated_color=color.gray)
